comment: Known var(--x) reads that have no fallback and no definition anywhere (styles.css,
dashboard-workflows.css, index.html and the renderer's JavaScript), written file|--property with the
number of such reads in that file. Each one makes its declaration invalid at computed-value time, so
the property silently falls back to inherited or initial. See tests/unit/css-undefined-properties.test.js.
This list only shrinks. Never add to it and never raise a count: define the property, give the var()
a fallback, or use the token that exists. When you fix reads the test fails until you lower the count
here, or delete the line once it reaches zero.
